text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Take care! Let's hang out again!!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
...There she goes.
I hope she does well over there too.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, I really hate goodbyes after all.
Going off to college, getting jobs... Everyone's
gradually going their separate ways...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even kindred spirits can end up walking different paths.
That doesn't mean it's goodbye forever, though.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Once I build my castle, I'll bring everyone together!
And then, we can all live happily together again!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Tap.
Guess it's bye-bye until then, huh... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Come here. If that loneliness won't fade, just cry your heart out against my chest.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And once your tears have dried up,
all that's left is to drink, eat, and dance our hearts out!
So that when we meet again someday, we can greet each other with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(It's almost time for training, but...
I can't just leave a friend behind. Sorry, Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite feeling a pang of guilt,
Tap Dance City ended up
skipping training after all...
